title: 第十二章 众目昭彰，太子颜面尽失
content_zh:
后园水榭围满了前来观望的世家宾客，窃窃私语声层层叠叠，像细密的潮水将萧景煜死死裹住。

    人人都是人精，眼前场面一目了然。四名被捆的人犯腰间藏着东宫暗卫专属令牌，桌上迷药尚在，方才几人鬼鬼祟祟围堵相府嫡女，意图再明显不过。

    平宁侯面色铁青，身为东道主，自家宴席险些闹出玷污贵女清白的丑事，还牵扯当朝太子，又惊又怒。他沉声开口：“太子殿下，臣自问侯府从未得罪东宫，不知殿下为何遣人潜入后园，蓄意加害沈家姑娘？”

    萧景煜背脊僵硬，面上维持的温润彻底崩裂。他目光慌乱扫过四周，想寻一句辩解的话，可物证、人证俱全，所有说辞都苍白可笑。

    他只能强压慌乱，硬着头皮抵赖：“侯府误会，这几人绝非本宫手下，定是有人蓄意伪造东宫令牌，栽赃陷害！”

    “栽赃？”

    清冷女声陡然响起。沈清鸢缓步上前，立于众人目光中央，眉眼平静却字字清晰，“今日我赴海棠宴，全程循规蹈矩，从未与人结怨。方才四人尾随于我，意图下药加害，全程被摄政王暗卫看得分明。令牌新鲜完整，绝非伪造，太子殿下一句栽赃，便可盖过全部证据吗？”

    她语气不疾不徐，却句句戳中要害。

    往日京中人人皆知，沈清鸢痴恋太子，事事迁就退让，可今日她从容凛然、条理清晰，半点痴傻柔弱的影子都无。围观贵女纷纷侧目，心底暗自改观。

    萧聿辞立在少女身侧，墨色眼眸覆着一层寒霜，淡淡开口补了最后一刀：“本王暗卫全程驻守取证，全程无半点偏差。此事若是传至御前，殿下觉得陛下会信推诿之词，还是信这实打实的人证物证？”

    这话彻底堵死萧景煜所有退路。

    天子最忌皇子结党营私、私蓄死士、构陷朝臣子女。今日之事，哪怕是太子，也绝不可能轻易揭过。

    周遭议论声越发响亮，指指点点落在萧景煜身上。
content_en:
The waterside pavilion in the back garden was filled with guests from aristocratic families who came to watch, and there were layers of whispers, like a fine tide wrapping Xiao Jingyu tightly.

Everyone is a human being, and the scene in front of them is clear at a glance.The four tied prisoners had the exclusive tokens of the secret guards of the East Palace hidden in their waists, and the drug was still on the table. Just now, a few people were sneaking around to surround the prime minister's daughter, and their intention was very obvious.

Marquis Pingning's face was livid. As the host, his banquet almost caused a scandal that tarnished the noble daughter's innocence, and also involved the prince of the dynasty. He was shocked and angry.He said in a deep voice: "Your Highness, the Prince, I ask myself that the Hou Mansion has never offended the East Palace. I wonder why Your Highness sent people to sneak into the back garden and deliberately harm the Shen family girls?"

Xiao Jingyu's back was stiff, and the warmth on his face completely collapsed.He glanced around frantically, looking for a word of defense, but with all the physical and personal evidence, all his excuses were pale and ridiculous.

He could only suppress his panic and deny it: "The Marquis has misunderstood. These people are definitely not my subordinates. Someone must have deliberately forged the East Palace token and framed me!"

"Framing?"

A cold female voice suddenly sounded.Shen Qingyuan stepped forward slowly and stood in the center of everyone's gaze. His brows were calm but his words were clear. "Today I went to the Haitang Banquet. I followed the rules throughout the process and never had any grudges with anyone. The four people followed me just now with the intention of drugging me. They were clearly seen by the regent's secret guards throughout the process. The token is fresh and complete, and it is definitely not forged. Can His Highness the Crown Prince's frame-up cover up all the evidence?"

Her tone was neither urgent nor slow, but her words hit the mark.

In the past, everyone in the capital knew that Shen Qingyuan was madly in love with the prince and would give in to everything, but today she is calm and dignified, clear-cut, and there is no trace of stupidity or weakness.The noble ladies onlookers all looked sideways, secretly changing their minds.

Xiao Yuci stood beside the girl, his dark eyes covered with a layer of frost, and said lightly to make up for the last blow: "My secret guards were stationed throughout the entire process to collect evidence, and there was no deviation in the entire process. If this matter reaches the imperial court, do you think Your Majesty will believe the words of blame, or the real human and material evidence?"

These words completely blocked all Xiao Jingyu's escape routes.

The emperor is most afraid of princes forming cliques for personal gain, secretly accumulating dead men, and plotting against the children of courtiers.Today's matter, even the prince, will never be able to expose it easily.

The comments around him became louder and louder, and fingers pointed at Xiao Jingyu.
